Behind the apps

Small studio.
Big curiosity.

Black Tides Software is an independent software company in Hartsville, South Carolina. We create mobile and web experiences for people who like to look a little closer.

Our Atlas collection brings maps and storytelling together, turning a location into a starting point for discovery. Different interests. Different atmospheres. The same curiosity at the heart of it all.

01

Start with a place.

Geography gives a story context. Our apps help you see where events happened and how places connect.

02

Make room for discovery.

Browse the map, search for something familiar, or follow a story somewhere unexpected.

03

Build with an identity.

History, the paranormal, and true crime each deserve an experience that feels like their own.
